toggler.note: Icon-only toggler; name from aria-label 'Toggle navigation'. Shows/hides the nav links.

nav-home.note: Nav link, visible on load (collapse starts expanded).

nav-features.note: Nav link, visible on load (collapse starts expanded).

dropdown-toggle.note: Native button that opens the Products dropdown; Escape closes it and refocuses the toggle.

dropdown-item-1.note: a.dropdown-item in the collapsed menu (display:none until opened). Hidden from everyone while closed, which is correct, not a gap.

dropdown-item-2.note: a.dropdown-item in the collapsed menu (display:none until opened). Hidden from everyone while closed, which is correct, not a gap.

dropdown-item-3.note: a.dropdown-item in the collapsed menu (display:none until opened). Hidden from everyone while closed, which is correct, not a gap.

dropdown-item-6.note: a.dropdown-item in the collapsed menu (display:none until opened). Hidden from everyone while closed, which is correct, not a gap.

hidden-csrf.note: input[type=hidden]: never rendered, focusable or operable; not a control.

hidden-locale.note: input[type=hidden]: never rendered, focusable or operable; not a control.

hidden-ref.note: input[type=hidden]: never rendered, focusable or operable; not a control.

offcanvas-open.note: Opens the off-canvas account menu and moves focus to its close button.

offcanvas-close.note: Icon-only close button (aria-label 'Close') in the off-canvas menu, which is visibility:hidden + translateX(-100%) until opened; not focusable while closed, which is correct.

offcanvas-link-1.note: Off-canvas link; visibility:hidden + translateX(-100%) until opened, so not focusable while closed, which is correct.

offcanvas-link-2.note: Off-canvas link; visibility:hidden + translateX(-100%) until opened, so not focusable while closed, which is correct.

offcanvas-link-3.note: Off-canvas link; visibility:hidden + translateX(-100%) until opened, so not focusable while closed, which is correct.

submit-button.note: Native submit button; the only way to submit (two text fields block implicit submission once it is gone).

custom-button.note: div role=button tabindex=0; click + keydown Enter/Space attached with addEventListener. Accessible: a clean positive.

custom-checkbox.note: div role=checkbox tabindex=0 aria-checked; click + keydown Space attached with addEventListener. Accessible: a clean positive.

native-button.note: Native button with an addEventListener click handler.

focus-guard-start.note: Radix-style focus guard: invisible tabindex=0 sentinel that bounces stray focus back into the dialog; not a control.

trigger.note: Opens the dialog. Inside the aria-hidden background while the dialog is open (correct modal pattern, not a gap); reachable after Escape, which returns focus here.

help-link.note: Background link. aria-hidden and unreachable while the dialog is open (correct modal pattern, not a gap); reachable after Escape.

name-input.note: Dialog field with <label for>; focus starts here on load.

save-button.note: Native button; saves and closes the dialog.

close-button.note: Icon-only close button (shadcn pattern): svg aria-hidden plus sr-only text 'Close' as its name.

focus-guard-end.note: Radix-style focus guard: invisible tabindex=0 sentinel that bounces stray focus back into the dialog; not a control.

add-to-cart-div.note: React <div onClick> with cursor:pointer, no role, no tabIndex: mouse-only 'Add to cart'. Chromium exposes it as an unignored generic AX node, so it is in the tree with the wrong role.

plain-div.note: Plain text div with no handler (negative control).

portal-host.note: The header <div> React portals the share button into. React 17+ marks it _reactListening and delegates the portal's events from it, but it is a container, not a control.

share-button.note: A native <button> React portals into the page header; focusable, named by its text, Enter works.

a-skip-link.note: Skip link to the product details; a native link.

float-tablist.note: The first tablist's container: zero height, because its tabs float and nothing inside it clears them. Its keydown handler serves the arrow keys for its tabs; a container, not a control.

float-tab-1.note: The selected tab (tabindex=0), a Tab stop; arrow keys move focus between the tabs (roving tabindex) and select the focused one.

float-tab-2.note: The unselected tab (tabindex=-1): out of the Tab order by design and reached with ArrowRight from the first tab (the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern), so keyboard-accessible.

contents-tablist.note: The second tablist's container: display: contents, so it has no box of its own. Its keydown handler serves the arrow keys for its tabs; a container, not a control.

contents-tab-1.note: The selected tab (tabindex=0), a Tab stop; arrow keys move focus between the tabs (roving tabindex) and select the focused one.

contents-tab-2.note: The unselected tab (tabindex=-1): out of the Tab order by design and reached with ArrowRight from the first tab (the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern), so keyboard-accessible.

faq-shipping.note: A <details> disclosure: a group, not a control; its <summary> is the control.

faq-shipping-summary.note: The <summary> that opens and closes its <details>: native, a Tab stop, Enter toggles it.

faq-returns.note: A <details> disclosure: a group, not a control; its <summary> is the control.

faq-returns-summary.note: The <summary> that opens and closes its <details>: native, a Tab stop, Enter toggles it.

shop-link.note: Behind the age-gate <dialog> that showModal() opens on load: inert until Confirm closes it, then reachable with Tab. Content a modal dialog blocks is not an accessibility gap.

join-button.note: Behind the age-gate <dialog> that showModal() opens on load: inert until Confirm closes it, then reachable with Tab. Content a modal dialog blocks is not an accessibility gap.

confirm-button.note: The age gate's Confirm button (a form method=dialog submit): focused when the dialog opens; Enter closes the dialog. Tab from it leaves the page for the browser's own UI, so the native modal is no trap.

only-button.note: The page's only Tab stop: a native button; Enter subscribes.

agree-button.note: A native button; Enter agrees. The two scroll regions after it are untagged Tab stops (keyboard-focusable scrollers) that the walk's focusable count does not include.

home-link.note: A native link. The page re-renders <main> on its first keydown, so Tab reaches a new node with the same markup.

about-link.note: A native link. The page re-renders <main> on its first keydown, so Tab reaches a new node with the same markup.

buy-button.note: A native button; its click handler is delegated to the document, so Enter works on the re-rendered node too.

cart-button.note: A role=button div with tabindex=0; Enter and Space are handled on the document, so it works on the re-rendered node too.
